name: stevens-presentation-tools
description: Reusable Stevens Institute of Technology presentation themes and Google Slides workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build Stevens-branded slides in two themes.
interface.longDescription: Stevens Presentation Tools provides White and Dark 16:9 templates, editable archetype exemplars, brand references, and a local-PPTX-first workflow for native Google Slides delivery.
defaultPrompt: Use $stevens-slides to create a Stevens-branded Google Slides presentation.
Use $stevens-slides-dark to build a technical presentation in the Stevens Dark theme.
